tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bka' 'bum po ti gnyis pa na bzhugs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ 001 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub pa byed tshul/ 002 mol gtam yid bzhin nor bu/ 003 rab gnas don gsal gyi gsal byed dngos grub 'byung ba/ 004 dpal yang dag pa mar me dgu pa'i sgrub thabs rim pa gsal ba/ 005 yang dag me dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga blo dman dga' ba bskyed byed/ 006 yang dag me dgu'i rdul tshon la rten pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod byed tshul ngag 'don gyi tho/ 007 dpal rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen bsgrub kyi gsal byed bdud rtsi'i 'od can zhes bya ba la sngags 'chang chen po'i mchan gnang ba/ 008 rdo rje phur pa'i stod las byang chub bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho gas rang gzhan smin byed kyi phyag len shin tu gsal ba yid 'ong blo gros kha 'byed/ 009 rdo rje phur pa'i dbang gi 'tshams sbyor blo gsal dga' ba bskyed byed/ 010 rdo rje phur bu dngos grub char 'bebs kyi 'cham gyi brjed byang snang ba 'gyur thub/ 011 stong ra chos rje kun dga' legs grub pa'i dris lan/ 012 dam can bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha bzhon pa rnams bstan pa/ 013 dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i sku bzhengs tshul yid bzhin nor bu mthong ba rang grol dang / 014 bsgrub rnga'i nang gzungs 'dri tshul la/ 015 gur gyi mgon po'i khro bcu'i bsrung 'khor rdo rje'i brag rdzong ma bar chad kun 111 sel dang / 016 dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i bsnyen pa'i gsal byed 'bar ba la/ 017 mgon po'i lus dkyil rdzogs rim bsgom tshul gyi khrid yig kha gsal gzhan phan rgyas byed/ 018 sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag len rim pa ji lta ba'i gtor chog 019 dpal sa skya pa'i bka' bsrung rnams kyi gtor chog rgyun gyi nyams len shin tu gsal ba'i phyag len ma 'bring po/

020 gtor chog bsdus pa shin tu nyams len bde ba bar chad kun bcom dngos grub mchog stsol/ 021 rang bsrung rgyas pa 'dri tshul shin tu gsal ba/ 022 dpal ldan sa skya pa'i chos skyong khyad par can rnams kyi dus gtor gyi phyag len rol yig dang / gson po'i skra dang sen mo la sāts+tsha btab pa'i yig chung la/ 023 bdag chen kun legs pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog sngags 'chang bka' 'bum po ti gnyis pa 'di/ /ngag dbang kun bsod dad dang brtson pas bsdebs/ /bsod nams 'di yis bdag cag dpon slob kyi/ /'di phyi'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig/ //sarba maṅgalaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 dkar chag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
